title: Petition of Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company, requesting authority from the Department of Public Utilities, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, §§ 75C and 105A, and G.L. c. 184, § 32 for the right to exercise the power of eminent domain under G.L. c. 79 for the right to take by eminent domain such rights-of-way, permanent easements, temporary easements or such other interests in land or other property necessary for the construction, operation, maintenance, alteration and/or removal of natural gas transmission pipelines, appliances, appurtenances and other equipment situated in the Town of Stockbridge, in the County of Berkshire, that are encumbered by conservation restrictions under G.L. c. 184, § 31.
